metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for documentation, diagrams, and developer productivity

plugins.name: app-diagram
plugins.description: Generate comprehensive state machine and sequence diagrams. Includes diagram-generator and diagram-updater agents (Opus) for thorough codebase analysis with Mermaid output.

plugins.name: icp-dev
plugins.description: Plugin to make Internet Computer (ICP) development feel native and seamless. The plugin provides slash commands for common workflows (local dev, deployment, cycles management) with safety guardrails for risky operations.
